Drone delivery — a 3D airspace in plan view

Delivery drones working a three-dimensional airspace, shown in plan view.

What to watch for

Altitude rides in the trace even though the picture is flat. Drones at different heights pass over one another without interacting, which is the point: the flattening is a choice the layout makes, not information the model lost.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (74 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
